beats.say: Tate McRae just hit number one in Australia with Housewife.
Billboard says it is the Canadian pop star's first chart leader.
It even beat her hit Greedy, which peaked at number two.
But she did not start out as a singer.
She actually began as a dancer on So You Think You Can Dance.
